as_told.title: Founding of Skywatcher to call in craft

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he once carried a UFO with his helicopter for a secret government program, says that after leaving that program he and others formed a company called Skywatcher Technologies. A member of the team, Matthew Pines, says its aim is to use private money and the skills they gained inside the program to gather enough evidence to convince more people that the phenomenon is real. Another member, James Valor, puts it differently: he says the company was created through UAP, the official term for unexplained objects in the sky. If true, people from inside a hidden government effort are now trying to show the public what they saw. So the story comes from the founders themselves, each describing the company in his own words on the same podcast.
